title: Diagonal 3D Chess
author: d_s_b
selftext:
Technology finally caught up and was able to re-make my old senior thesis; **Diagonal 3D Chess.**

# [https://github.com/dansternofbeyer/diagonal-3d-chess](https://github.com/dansternofbeyer/diagonal-3d-chess)

You can even play it in the browser now. We're living in the future. Click around and let me know what you think.

\_\_\_

Luckily, when I made this 20 years ago in Director, I also made a very thorough website that explained every single element of the game. (https://thehinge.net/3dchess). When I fed this website to Claude (Opus 5.5 Medium) it just ate it up.

  
Turns out if you **rigorously document stuff with pictures and explainations**, it goes A LONG way when upgrading a project with AI.

Claude took about 20 minutes and delivered a functional 90% of the game. Then I did back forth for a few hours to get the rest cleaned up.

I think I might try and ask Claude to write a AI opponent, just to see if it can play in this space.

.
